description: A lightweight, concealable bullet resistant vest.  It will reliably protect against anything up to 9x19mm, but will struggle against tougher rounds like .45 ACP or .357 Magnum.

An improved iteration of a flexible, bullet-resistant vest that originally suffered from reliability issues.  Reliably protects against 5.56x45mm rounds while being less cumbersome than normal hard ballistic armor.  Damaged plates will require it to be disassembled to replace.
//: Ceramic disks inside block addition of steel plating modification

description: A lamellar Kevlar vest, providing modest protection from pistol rounds up to .40 S&W.  It was designed to slot in multiple small ceramic disks to improve bullet resistance.

A low profile, lightweight plate carrier.  It offers almost no soft armor protection on its own, and does not fully cover the torso.  It has pouches for ballistic armor plates: with mild steel plates it will protect against 9x19mm rounds, hardened steel will protect against .357 Magnum, and ceramic plates will protect against 5.56x45mm rounds.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

A Modular Scalable Vest.  This one is in standard plate carrier configuration, and provides excellent soft armor protection for the torso against anything up to .40 S&W without ballistic plates.  It has pouches for ballistic armor plates, allowing them to be worn.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

A Modular Scalable Vest.  This one is in full protection configuration, and provides excellent soft armor protection for the torso, and somewhat of the arms and legs, against anything up to .40 S&W without ballistic plates.  It has pouches for ballistic armor plates, allowing them to be worn.  It has four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

A set of polygonal ceramic ballistic plates.  They are highly protective and relatively lightweight, and reliably negate anything up to armor-piercing .30-06 rounds when worn with soft armor, but are fragile and cannot maintain integrity for many shots, nor can they be repaired.  These are intended to be worn in a plate carrier.

A set of polygonal hard steel ballistic plates.  They are highly protective and durable, and reliably negate anything up to 7.62x51mm, but practically require soft armor and cost a great deal of weight and loss of flexibility.  These are intended to be worn in a plate carrier.

A set of polygonal steel ballistic plates.  They are highly protective and durable, and reliably negate anything up to 5.56x45mm, but practically require soft armor and cost some weight and loss of flexibility.  These are intended to be worn in a plate carrier.

A set of polygonal superalloy ballistic plates.  They are highly protective and durable, and reliably negate anything up to 5.56x45mm, all with marginal flexibility loss and additional weight, but practically require soft armor.  These are intended to be worn in a plate carrier.

Pieces of scrap metal crudely cut, taped, and bent into the shape of polygonal ballistic plates, wrapped in rags to cover the sharp edges.  When paired with a proper vest it will just barely protect against .223 Remington, and won't stop armor-piercing 5.56x45mm rounds or anything stronger, but it's better than nothing.  Must be worn in a plate carrier.

A military ballistic vest rated for .40 S&W, modified with additional protective panels to improve coverage at the expense of limb encumbrance.  Made and used by military remnants to provide robust protection against the new threats of the cataclysm.  It has pouches for ballistic armor plates, allowing them to be worn, along with four pouches capable of carrying magazines.

A flotation vest, cut open and tightly packed with sand or earth as improvised ballistic protection.  Incredibly cumbersome, it won't do much but it'll keep your organs inside your torso against anything up to .40 S&W.
//: Mono-material as it likely would need to be taken apart to repair, plus the material of the vest is less of a factor on resistances.

description: Cumbersome body armor forged from hardened steel plating.  Very heavy, but able to take considerable punishment, laughing off anything up to .44 Magnum.
//: 44-45 kg is the commonly cited value for the complete set, possible figure of 9 kg for the helm.

description: A cumbersome full-face helm forged from hardened steel plating.  Very heavy, but able to take considerable punishment, laughing off anything up to .44 Magnum.
